tools.name: restaurant-operations_recipe-cost-calculate
tools.description: Calculate recipe and per-portion cost from supplied ingredient quantities and prices after unit conversion. Missing prices are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/recipe-cost-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_menu-item-margin-analyze
tools.description: Calculate gross margin and food-cost percentage from supplied sell prices and calculated recipe costs. Nutritional values are not invented. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/menu-item-margin-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_ingredient-price-variance
tools.description: Compare supplied supplier prices for the same ingredient after unit conversion and report spreads and dated changes. Prices are never invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/ingredient-price-variance. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_food-waste-estimate
tools.description: Estimate waste cost from supplied waste quantities and ingredient prices after unit conversion. Missing prices are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/food-waste-estimate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_recipe-yield-normalize
tools.description: Normalize recipe line quantities into ingredient units and per-portion amounts using accurate mass and volume conversions. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/recipe-yield-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_menu-profitability-rank
tools.description: Rank menu items by contribution using calculated portion profit and supplied sales units. Ties fall back to gross margin. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/menu-profitability-rank. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_allergen-matrix-validate
tools.description: Compare menu allergen claims with explicitly supplied ingredient allergen flags. Allergen status is never invented and food-safety compliance is not claimed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/allergen-matrix-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: restaurant-operations_food-cost-report
tools.description: Combine recipe costs, margins, price variance, waste estimates, yield normalization, profitability ranking, and allergen validation from supplied data. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaurant-operations/food-cost-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
